facilities.name: St. Elmo Robotaxi Charging Hub
facilities.address: 405 E St Elmo Rd, Austin, TX 78745
facilities.summary: Planned two-phase Robotaxi charging site across the road from Tesla's St. Elmo service center.
facilities.description: A vehicle storage lot across E St. Elmo Rd from Tesla's St. Elmo service center. Permit filings reported in August 2026 show a two-phase Robotaxi charging site. No opening date has been announced.
charging: Phase 1: 48 Supercharger posts (most reports say V4; one says V3)
Phase 2: up to 80 wireless inductive chargers for Cybercab, fed by V4 cabinets
facilities.photoReview: No location photographs with reuse permission found (Wikimedia Commons searched; none geotagged within 300 m). Coverage shows permit filings, not the site.

sources.title: Tesla Plans Charging Hub in Austin With 80 Wireless Chargers
Tesla gears up for Cybercab robotaxi launch, leases an 80 wireless charger location in Austin, Texas
Permit filing: 80 wireless chargers in Phase 2

facilities.name: Ridgepoint Robotaxi Charging Site
facilities.summary: Planned 24-post fleet charging depot at Tesla's Ridgepoint site in northeast Austin.
facilities.description: Tesla's Austin-Ridgepoint service center site. A site plan filed in June 2026 under a project named "2323 Ridgepoint Dr – Robotaxi" adds a fleet charging depot; the drawings and permit record don't state the purpose outright. No opening date has been announced.
charging: No wireless charging pads in the plans
A 2,500 kVA transformer serving a 4,000 A switchboard
facilities.photoReview: No location photographs with reuse permission found (Wikimedia Commons searched; none geotagged within 300 m). Tesla's own Find Us page shows the service center, not the charging depot.

facilities.name: Irving Robotaxi Hub
facilities.summary: Planned Robotaxi and Cybercab hub: charging, storage, dispatch and service. Zoning approved July 16, 2026.
facilities.description: A 35,049 sq ft warehouse remodel planned as a Robotaxi and Cybercab operations hub, from which the fleet would be dispatched, serviced, repaired, cleaned and charged. Irving City Council approved the zoning change on July 16, 2026. Outside the Dallas service zone.
charging: 16 V4 Supercharger stalls near the maintenance building
staging: 212 vehicle storage spots on the north part of the property
Fleet dispatch, service, repair and cleaning on site
facilities.photoReview: Drive-by photos exist (@scotsrule08 on X, May 21, 2026; EV Wire "First look"), but none with reuse permission. Ask the photographers before adding them.

facilities.name: Dallas Cedar Springs Staging Ground
facilities.address: Near Cedar Springs Rd & W Mockingbird Ln, Dallas, TX 75235
facilities.locationNote: A parking lot at the northwest corner of Cedar Springs Rd and W Mockingbird Ln, by Dallas Love Field. It's across the street from Tesla's Cedar Springs service center (6500 Cedar Springs Rd), which is a separate site.
facilities.summary: Parking lot where rows of Cybercabs have been photographed, reportedly staged ahead of a possible public rollout.
facilities.description: A parking lot where rows of Cybercabs have been photographed. They've reportedly been staged in preparation for a possible public rollout in Dallas. Tesla hasn't confirmed that it runs the lot as a staging facility, and hasn't announced a public launch date.
staging: Rows of Cybercabs photographed parked on the lot
Across the street, Tesla's Cedar Springs service center cleans and services Robotaxis and validation Cybercabs (Road to Autonomy field report, Nov 2, 2026)
